verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS AI video platform with a web workspace and API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, analytics opt-out, usage tracking controls, or data-use settings. The sign-in complaint concerns authentication options, not tracking, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
